proposal.reason: Main change is in P2P IPC transport registration: it now registers/maps full multi-segment physical allocations, batches FD conversion, tracks per-segment imports, and hardens deregistration/teardown paths. Add memory because allocation/free and registration-lifecycle semantics changed (segment-aware hgMem/hggc free helpers and deregister callback draining to prevent stale reused-address mappings). Add network because proxy-side FD/query and proxy connection handle-queue lifecycle were substantively extended in shared proxy infrastructure, not just caller wiring.
